name: Batch Management Response V 04
definition: The BatchManagementResponse message is sent by any party to any party (acquirer, agent or issuer) in response to a BatchManagementInitiation message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the management of the protocol.

CollectionIdentification.name: Collection Identification
CollectionIdentification.definition: Identification of a collection.|Mandatory for start or end of a collection and their acknowledgements if the batch is included in a collection.|All the messages included within the collection will have the same collection identification value.

BatchIdentification.name: Batch Identification
BatchIdentification.definition: Identification of a batch.|All the messages included within the batch will have the same batch identification value.

CollectionSize.name: Collection Size
CollectionSize.definition: Total length in bytes of the collection to be transferred.

OriginalCollectionIdentification.name: Original Collection Identification
OriginalCollectionIdentification.definition: Identification of the original collection.|Mandatory when the collection containing the batch response has not the same identification as the collection containing the original batch.

OriginalBatchIdentification.name: Original Batch Identification
OriginalBatchIdentification.definition: Identification of the original batch to answer.|Mandatory when the batch response has not the same identification as the batch initiation.

NumberOfBatchesInCollection.name: Number Of Batches In Collection
NumberOfBatchesInCollection.definition: Number of batches in the collection.|For a start of collection, this is the number of expected batches if known.|For a start of collection acknowledgement, this is the maximum number of batches that can be received in the collection.|For an end of collection, this is the number of batches sent in the closing collection.|For an end of collection acknowledgement, this is the number of batches received in the collection.

NumberOfMessages.name: Number Of Messages
NumberOfMessages.definition: Number of messages.||For a start of collection, this is the number of expected messages in the collection if known. ||For a start of batch, this is the number of expected messages in the batch if known.||For an AcknowledgementRequest , this is the number of sent messages since last check point.||For an AcknowledgementResponse, this is the number of received messages since last check point.||For an end of batch this is the number of received messages in the batch.||For an end of collection, this is the number of received messages in the collection.||Note: Batch management messages are excluded from the count.

RemainingMessagesInCollection.name: Remaining Messages In Collection
RemainingMessagesInCollection.definition: Number of remaining messages in the collection.

MessageSequenceNumber.name: Message Sequence Number
MessageSequenceNumber.definition: For a start of collection, sequence number of first expected message of the collection. ||For a start of batch, sequence number of first expected message of the batch.||For an AcknowledgementRequest , sequence number of the last message sent for this checkpoint.||For an AcknowledgementResponse, sequence number of the last message received for this checkpoint.||For an end of batch, sequence number of last message of the batch.||For an end of collection, sequence number of last message of the collection.

CollectionIdentificationList.name: Collection Identification List
CollectionIdentificationList.definition: List of collection identification that should have been sent or received.

BatchIdentificationList.name: Batch Identification List
BatchIdentificationList.definition: List of batch identifications of the collection.|For a start of collection, the identification of expected batches, if known.|For an end of collection, this is the identification of batches sent in the closing collection.|For an end of collection acknowledgement, this is the identification of batches received in the collection.

CollectionChecksum.name: Collection Checksum
CollectionChecksum.definition: Checksum of the series of messages or batches in the collection.

BatchChecksum.name: Batch Checksum
BatchChecksum.definition: Checksum of the series of messages in the batch or until a checkpoint.

RequestAcknowledgement.name: Request Acknowledgement
RequestAcknowledgement.definition: Indicator to request acknowledgement.|True: Acknowledgement requested|False: Acknowledgement not requested.

MessagesBeforeAcknowledgement.name: Messages Before Acknowledgement
MessagesBeforeAcknowledgement.definition: Maximum number of messages to be sent before acknowledgement. The receiver will send an acknowledgement response every time the indicated number of messages is reached.

PositiveAcknowledgement.name: Positive Acknowledgement
PositiveAcknowledgement.definition: Indicate whether the acknowledgement is positive or not.|True: Positive acknowledgement.|False: Negative acknowledgement.

Continuation.name: Continuation
Continuation.definition: Indicates that batch or collection is not complete.

Originator.name: Originator
Originator.definition: Identifies the originator of the transaction.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Party sending the message to another intermediary agent or to the final destination.

Receiver.name: Receiver
Receiver.definition: Party receiving the message from the origin or from an intermediary agent.

Destination.name: Destination
Destination.definition: Identifies the destination of the transaction.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Programme, network, or brand processes the transaction.

SystemTraceAuditNumber.name: System Trace Audit Number
SystemTraceAuditNumber.definition: Number assigned by a transaction originator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages within a two-message exchange (for example, request/repeat and response)

TransmissionDateTime.name: Transmission Date Time
TransmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time expressed in UTC of the message as sent by the initiator.

RetrievalReferenceNumber.name: Retrieval Reference Number
RetrievalReferenceNumber.definition: A reference supplied by the system retaining the original source information and used to assist in locating that information or a copy thereof.

Correction.name: Correction
Correction.definition: Identifies that this batch or collection is a corrected version of a batch or collection that was previously sent.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Contains information that identifies or is specific to a transaction jurisdiction.

SettlementService.name: Settlement Service
SettlementService.definition: Type of settlement service for specific services requiring settlement.

AdditionalFee.name: Additional Fee
AdditionalFee.definition: Fees not included in the transaction amount.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period between the acquirer and the issuer or their respective agents.

OriginalResponseCode.name: Original Response Code
OriginalResponseCode.definition: Original Response code defined in ISO 8583.

ProtectedData.name: Protected Data
ProtectedData.definition: Contains protected data and the attributes used to protect the data.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC
